dē-fingo , nxi, 3,
I.v. a., to form, to put in shape, to fashion (very rare; prob. belonging properly to the vulgar lang.; “hence in Hor., by way of sarcasm): panem,” Cato R. R. 74 and 121.—Sarcast. of coarse poetic description: dum Defingit Rheni luteum caput, * Hor. S. 1, 10, 37.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
